[center][img src=https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/guide/images/33328.jpg width=200 alt="Unstable Sentinel"][/center]
[center][b]Strategy[/b][/center]
[npc=246017] has one defining mechanic, and that is [spell=1241329]. Malfunction will have a short wind-up before unleashing heavy AOE damage to anyone within 25 yards. Ranged players should stay at max range for the entire fight, and melee players should run out whenever you see the wind-up. Depending on your level and group composition, you could likely stay in as a melee, but being kind to the healer should be the baseline. 

[i]Note: Non-elite enemies called [npc=254856] will spawn from the buildings as you approach the boss. Kill these before engaging the fight to make things a little bit easier. [/i]

[center][b]Strategy[/b][/center]
[npc=246008] resides by the entrance to Violet Hold and can be deceptively difficult. The boss will periodically cast [spell=1240750], which deals damage to everyone within 45 yards and drains 200 mana. 

Additionally, the boss will cast [spell=1240738] on the current target, dealing arcane damage on impact and over a 10-second duration.

This boss is essentially a rush against time, as the group will sooner or later run out of mana unless you defeat the boss quickly enough. The boss is also immune to arcane spells. 

[i][b]Note: Make sure to clear out all the trash in the boss area. They will join the fight after engaging the boss if they are still alive.[/b][/i]

[center][b]Strategy[/b][/center]
[npc=246003] has two mechanics that are quite unforgiving. [spell=22994] will occasionally root 2 targets and deal damage over time. This is not a big deal on its own, but when combined with his other mechanic [spell=1240706], it can be quite deadly. Fel Timbers leaves a green pool on the ground that deals damage to anyone standing in it. If Entangle and Fel Timbers overlap, make sure to use effects like [spell=1044] or [spell=20589] to clear it. 

[i]Note: [npc=246003] is only unlocked once surrounding bosses are defeated and the mana barrier protecting him is broken.[/i]

[center][b]Strategy[/b][/center]
[npc=247032] is a secret boss hiding away in the sewers. After summoning him, you'll have to deal with a surprisingly punishing encounter. 

[spell=17228] will be cast periodically and deals a surprising amount of shadow damage. On its own, it's not too difficult to handle, but when combined with damage from [spell=1304473], things can get scary. This ability gives your attacks a chance to cause damage to yourself, which is bad news for melee classes, particularly Rogues. This is a curse, so make sure to dispel it if possible.

The boss will also cast [spell=1303266], which summons two non-elite skeletons, similar to [npc=247126].

[center][b]Strategy[/b][/center]
[npc=246020] is the final boss of the dungeon. The Archmage uses his mana pool to use his abilities, and once that mana pool is drained, he will use [spell=1303598] and [spell=1303599] to regenerate his mana to full. 

His primary damage ability on the tank is [spell=15230], which deals high steady damage. He'll also periodically use [spell=28450], which deals moderate damage to anyone within 20 yards. Occasionally, the Archmage will cast [spell=1241515], which deals high damage to anyone hit. This will target one individual player with an arcane boomerang projectile, and anyone standing in the projectile will take damage. 

Stay spread out to avoid spreading the damage from Bounding Mana, and casters stay at max range to avoid taking damage from Arcane Explosion. 

Casters who are looking to squeeze a bit more damage or healing out of the fight can hide behind the wall whenever the boss casts Mass Polymorph, but be careful, as if the boss leaves his room, he will fully reset.

hall_of_thanes.overview:
The Hall of Thanes Overview in WoW Forever
 
 
Hidden beneath the High Seat of Ironforge, the Hall of Thanes is part of the legendary "Old Ironforge", forever incapable of access in Classic Azeroth until WoW: Forever. The Hall of Thanes is the resting place of the Legendary Dwarves of the Eastern Kingdoms, but has recently been invaded by the hostile Dark Iron Dwarves

hall_of_thanes.location:
Location of The Hall of Thanes in WoW Forever
 
 
The Hall of Thanes is easy to get into. Players can find the open door to Old Ironforge immediately to the left after entering the High Seat of Ironforge. Players will follow the path all the way to the bottom of Old Ironforge to find the portal

 

[small]Click the image to expand
 

Currently, Horde will have a long travel time to get here, as so far, there is no quick travel for the opposing faction of this dungeon to get here, and none have been discovered yet in-game. Horde will have to travel from Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad, venture through Arathi Highlands, Wetlands, and Loch Modan before arriving in Dun Morogh to make their way into the Dwarven capital of Ironforge. Horde players should probably remove their gear before getting close, as they'll more than likely meet their demise at the hands of the Ironforge guards several times before being able to zone in (for new players, removing gear prevents it from taking durability loss when you die).

 

 

As with many World of Warcraft Forever Dungeons, wiping (the entire group dying) in The Hall of Thanes can be a frustrating time. 

Ideally, if the entire group is not dead, you should be able to get a rez (resurrection). This is a spell someone casts on you to bring your character back to life with a small amount of health and mana. Priests, Druids, and Shamans learn this early; Paladins need to complete a quest to learn resurrection and may not have it. 

If you can't get a rez, click to release your spirit, then run back to the dungeon from the Spirit Healer (marked on the map below) as a ghost. You collect your body when you enter the instance. Luckily, the Spirit Healer is not that far, as it's only located right outside the city.

 



 

 
[/section-header]

[h2 type=bar]Noteworthy Trash Mobs[/h2]

[h3 toc="Looter and Engineer"]Dark Iron Looter and Dark Iron Engineer[/h3]
The intro mobs are not too serious, and the trash only gets challenging once you get to the Dark Iron side. The [npc=263396]s deal rapid auto attacks with their daggers, and pulling too many at once can really drain your tank's health fast! The [npc=263397] will throw bombs at their target location.

[pad]
[center][table][tr][td][screenshot id=1302630 border=2 alt="Hall of Thanes Trash" size=normal width=700][/screenshot][/td][/tr][/table][/center]
[pad]

[b]Strategy:[/b] It is not too hard to take these mobs down; we just recommend not pulling too many at once, especially at lower levels since you are missing most of your toolkits at this level. You can dodge the [npc=263397]s bombs as they pick a location once they start the throw, so their bomb damage is 100% avoidable. With that being said, you should focus down the looters as their damage is rapid and can be deadly the more you pull.


[h3 toc="Summoner and Fiery Assistant"]Dark Iron Summoner and Fiery Assistant[/h3]
[npc=263438] is a caster-type mob that casts Fireballs and will summon a [spell=1291218]

[pad]
[center][table][tr][td][screenshot id=1302633 size=normal border=2 alt="Hall of Thanes Trash" width=700][/screenshot][/td][td][/td][/tr][/table][/center]
[pad]

[b]Strategy: [/b]Use any sort of pillar or wall to be out of line of sight of the Summoner, preventing them from casting and making them run towards the party. 


[h3]Lesser Stone Golem[/h3]
These [npc=263466]s deal intense damage and have increased movement speed. 

[pad]
[center][table][tr][td][screenshot id=1302627 size=normal border=2 alt="Hall of Thanes Trash" width=400][/screenshot][/td]][/tr][/table][/center]
[pad]

[b]Strategy:[/b] If you can, pull one at a time, and when you pull multiple, focus one down, then the other; do not split damage up. The final pack has one Summoner, Looter, and Lesser Stone Golem. We recommend using crowd control like [spell=118] to only make two active at the start of the encounter. Take out the Stone Golem first, then the Looter. Use stuns like [spell=853] to make this easier as well.
[pad]

[h2 type=bar]Bosses[/h2]
[pad]
[grid column-width=500 align=centered]
[div][box][h3 type=bar] Faldrim Anvilmar [/h3]
[center][screenshot id=1302641 alt="Faldrim Anvilmar" size=normal width=350][/screenshot][/center]
[center][b]Strategy[/b][/center]
[npc=261306] patrols the center of Anvilmar's Rest and is a simple tank-and-spank fight. The main concern from this is accidentally pulling the boss with any trash should it patrol too close to your party. Clear out a section of the room, wait for him to patrol to your side, then pull. He will auto-attack and cast [b]Mind Blast[/b], and will apply a 10-minute [b]Curse of Anvilmar[/b] to the tank.[pad][br]

[npc=261316] is accompanied by a [npc=263438] and has a couple of abilities that really put a focus on healing. On pull, the tank should pull the boss away from the rest of the party, focusing down the Summoner, as the boss will cast a [b]Fire Nova[/b]-like ability every so often. After the Summoner is taken down, focus the boss down. Magmatus will also cast [b]Combust[/b] on a random player[pad]

[center][b]Strategy[/b][/center]
[npc=261311] patrols his hallway and only has one ability: a [b]Knockback[/b]. All you need to do is pull this boss into a safe area where you won't get knocked into any other mobs. Have everyone positioned against a wall or corner to add additional mitigation to this mechanic. [pad]

bosses.name: Witherfang
bosses.text:
Strategy 
[npc=250483] patrols King's Alley and is a simple tank-and-spank fight. They're accompanied by two spider mobs, and those should be taken down asap. Use stuns to make this fight easier and cleanse the Leech Poison debuff off of the tank when applied. 
 
[/box-highlight]

bosses.name: The Baron
bosses.text:
Strategy 
[npc=250660] is a hard-hitting boss with one main ability, Knockout. This deals high instant damage and has a threat drop in it. If your tank is not at full HP, this ability can kill the tank. Use stuns to keep the boss from casting this.
 
[/box-highlight]

bosses.name: Viktor The Vile
bosses.text:
Strategy 
[npc=256035] is found when players activate the fire in the chimney located in the building to the southwest in Lordamere Overlook by the Lordaeron Graveyard. Players must clear 5 waves of adds before fighting Viktor. He only has powerful melee swings and the same Leech Poison ability as Witherfang, so make sure you let the tank get aggro first 
 
[/box-highlight]

bosses.name: The Abandoned
bosses.text:
Strategy 
[npc=250631] will be found as soon as you enter Market Street from Lordamere Overlook. The statue in this area will trigger 3 waves of adds before The Abandoned comes out. He will Frost Nova players, apply a chill effect to those who physically hit him, and cast Drain Life on the tank. 
 
[/box-highlight]

bosses.name: Bjork
bosses.text:
Strategy 
[npc=256097] only has one ability: a very short Anti-Magic Shield . It goes away pretty fast, so this boss is a very quick tank and spank. 
 
[/box-highlight]

bosses.name: Rath'Mael
bosses.text:
Strategy 
[npc=250657] has one ability: Flamestrike. Move out of it as soon as he channels the cast, as it's always cast where the tank was when the cast started. You can also stun him to prevent him from casting it altogether. 
 
[/box-highlight]

ruins_of_lordaeron.overview:
The Ruins of Lordaeron Overview in WoW Forever
 
 
The Ruins of Lordaeron holds remnants of the Scourge from the story of Warcraft III that still haunt the Forsaken in their home of Tirisfal Glades. Players must venture into this scourge-infested territory to push back the Lich King's army away from Lordaeron.

The recommended level for The Ruins of Lordaeron is between 16 and 22, and it has started developing the nickname of "RoL".

ruins_of_lordaeron.location:
Location of The Ruins of Lordaeron in WoW Forever
 
 
The Ruins of Lordaeron is easy to get into, especially for Horde players. Horde: find the portal above the Undercity, in the non-instanced Ruins of Lordaeron, where they can enter from Tirisfal Glades south of Brill.



Horde players can simply go to the uninstanced Ruins of Lordaeron above the Undercity to find the dungeon entrance

 
Entrance to Ruins of Lordaeron
 


Getting to Ruins of Lordaeron as Alliance will be a bit of a trek. Alliance Skyborne can skip to Step 6 as they have a portal from the Stormwind City Mage Tower to Dalaran.
[ol]
 Take the boat to Auberdine from Stormwind Harbor 
 Once the boat lands in Auberdine, go to the opposite side of the port to take the boat to Menethil Harbor 
 Stay on this Boat until it takes you to Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills 
 Follow the road from Southshore to the Hillsbrad Fields 
 Continue North and pass around Dalaran 
 Swim North through Lordamere Lake of Silverpine Forest to Tirisfal Glades 
 Follow the road to the Ruins of Lordaeron entrance from Tirisfal Glades

As with many World of Warcraft Forever Dungeons, wiping (the entire group dying) in The Ruins of Lordaeron can be a frustrating time. 

Ideally, if the entire group is not dead, you should be able to get a rez (resurrection). This is a spell someone casts on you to bring your character back to life with a small amount of health and mana. Priests, Druids, and Shamans learn this early; Paladins need to complete a quest to learn resurrection and may not have it. 

If you can't get a rez, click to release your spirit, then run back to the dungeon from the Spirit Healer as a ghost. The Ruins of Lordaerons Spirit Healer is located immediately outside the dungeon, so wiping here will not be as frustrating as other dungeons.

[h2 type=bar toc="Overview"]The Ruins of Lordaeron Overview in WoW Forever[/h2]
[pad]
[pad]
[box][i]The Ruins of Lordaeron holds remnants of the Scourge from the story of Warcraft III that still haunt the Forsaken in their home of Tirisfal Glades. Players must venture into this scourge-infested territory to push back the Lich King's army away from Lordaeron.[/i][/box]

The recommended level for The Ruins of Lordaeron is between 16 and 22, and it has started developing the nickname of "RoL".  

[h2 type=bar toc="Location"]Location of The Ruins of Lordaeron in WoW Forever[/h2]
[pad]
[pad]
The Ruins of Lordaeron is easy to get into, especially for Horde players. Horde: find the portal above the Undercity, in the non-instanced Ruins of Lordaeron, where they can enter from Tirisfal Glades south of Brill.

[tabs name="location"]
[tab name="Horde"]
[span class=icon-horde][/span][b][color=q10]Horde [/color][/b] players can simply go to the uninstanced Ruins of Lordaeron above the Undercity to find the dungeon entrance

[center][map zone=1497]
[pin x=70 y=10]Entrance to Ruins of Lordaeron
[/pin][/map][/center]
[/tab]
[tab name="Alliance"]
Getting to Ruins of Lordaeron as [span class=icon-alliance][/span][b][color=q3]Alliance[/color][/b] will be a bit of a trek. Alliance Skyborne can skip to Step 6 as they have a portal from the Stormwind City Mage Tower to Dalaran.
[ol]
[li]Take the boat to Auberdine from Stormwind Harbor [/li]
[li]Once the boat lands in Auberdine, go to the opposite side of the port to take the boat to Menethil Harbor[/li]
[li]Stay on this Boat until it takes you to Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills[/li]
[li]Follow the road from Southshore to the Hillsbrad Fields[/li]
[li]Continue North and pass around Dalaran[/li]
[li]Swim North through Lordamere Lake of Silverpine Forest to Tirisfal Glades[/li]
[li]Follow the road to the Ruins of Lordaeron entrance from Tirisfal Glades[/li]
[/ol]

[center]
[section-header="The Ruins of Lordaeron Death and Wipe Recovery" width=600 collapse=true icon=INV_Misc_QuestionMark level=2 margin=half heading=none]
   [div]

As with many World of Warcraft Forever Dungeons, wiping (the entire group dying) in The Ruins of Lordaeron can be a frustrating time. 

Ideally, if the entire group is not dead, you should be able to get a rez (resurrection). This is a spell someone casts on you to bring your character back to life with a small amount of health and mana.  Priests, Druids, and Shamans learn this early; Paladins need to complete a quest to learn resurrection and may not have it.  

If you can't get a rez, click to release your spirit, then run back to the dungeon from the Spirit Healer as a ghost. The Ruins of Lordaerons Spirit Healer is located immediately outside the dungeon, so wiping here will not be as frustrating as other dungeons.

[b]Strategy:[/b] Be careful when you pull them and avoid getting knocked into other packs. They patrol Lordamere Overlook, which has a healthy amount of trash around the area. 
[pad]


[h3 toc="Ghouls"]Ghouls and Ragged Ghouls[/h3]
These [npc=250627]s and [npc=250622]s deal intense damage and come in packs of 3-4. They are in close quarters with other packs as well.

[pad]
[center][table][tr][td][screenshot id=1303259 size=normal border=2 alt="Ruins of Lordaeron Trash" width=400][/screenshot][/td]][/tr][/table][/center]
[pad]

[b]Strategy:[/b] Be careful when you pull them, as it's very easy to pull multiple packs by accident. They have powerful melee swings, so avoid overpulling, as it can be overwhelming for your tank and healer. 

[pad]

[npc=250483] patrols King's Alley and is a simple tank-and-spank fight. They're accompanied by two spider mobs, and those should be taken down asap. Use stuns to make this fight easier and cleanse the [b]Leech Poison[/b] debuff off of the tank when applied.[pad][br]

[center][b]Strategy[/b][/center]
[npc=250660] is a hard-hitting boss with one main ability, [b]Knockout[/b]. This deals high instant damage and has a threat drop in it. If your tank is not at full HP, this ability can kill the tank. Use stuns to keep the boss from casting this.

[npc=256035] is found when players activate the fire in the chimney located in the building to the southwest in Lordamere Overlook by the Lordaeron Graveyard. Players must clear 5 waves of adds before fighting Viktor. He only has powerful melee swings and the same [b]Leech Poison[/b] ability as Witherfang, so make sure you let the tank get aggro first [pad]

[npc=250631] will be found as soon as you enter Market Street from Lordamere Overlook. The statue in this area will trigger 3 waves of adds before The Abandoned comes out.
